title: GDPR and Leanplum marketing data sharing
body:
Hi, just a fast question, are you sure that the marketing data share with leanplum enabled by default without used consent is OK for GDPR and EU cookie law?

┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-9169)
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: I have forwarded this query to the Legal team. It may be into the new year before it is possible to respond. Mozilla has most of the rest of December as PTO

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: The reply I got was to contact compliance@mozilla.com directly with your questions. There is not anything that can be done in this issue. Closing.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
